main.desc: crt0 (_start, _exit, ExitThread root stub), crtbegin (frame_dummy / EH frame registration), and the bootstrap's main(): boot-source selection (DISK/MCARD 0/MCARD 1/HOST), IRX loading, IOP reboot, pad init, launching core.gt3 via ExecPS2 with argv {path, "hot"}

startup.desc: startup/warning screen: its display thread, frame drawing, CLUT fade animation, Tex1 image relocation/upload (the texture is the embedded gzip 'startupa.img' in .data at 0x01027F38..0x01033C98)

sha512.desc: SHA-512 (init, 80-round compression function F_01001320, update/final, digest helpers); K table in .rodata at 0x0103DF18

filename.desc: FileName_Base and derived HostFileName / MCardFileName / DiskFileName classes (RTTI 13FileName_Base etc.), their vtables and static ctor/dtor, plus host_file_exists

imageloader.desc: ImageLoader: Source / HostSource / DiskSource / MCardSource / MCardSource_2<N,M> classes, the Buffer helper class, core.gt3 container parsing, DEFLATE decompression, and the RSA+SHA-512 signature verification (ImageLoader::verify F_010044A8, load F_010049C8). THE MOST IMPORTANT UNIT: verify must be decompiled exactly.

bignum.desc: arbitrary-precision integer library, part 1 (refcounted copy-on-write sign-magnitude bignums): gcd, modInverse, big-endian byte import, add/sub/compare/resize, truncated multiply, multiply/divide/mod cores

montgomery.desc: arbitrary-precision integer library, part 2: divmod, shifts, Montgomery context (ctor F_01009128, dtor F_01008FC0), REDC MontMul F_01009F68, modular exponentiation F_0100A5D0

gzip.desc: GZIP::InflateBase (raw DEFLATE inflater: huffman table build, block decode, stored/fixed/dynamic blocks) and crc32

gs.desc: the bootstrap's own GS/graphics driver: display/draw environment setup, VIF1/GIF DMA packet building, vsync, INTC handlers, sceGsResetGraph wrappers, texture upload

io.desc: game-side I/O helpers: synchronous memory-card wrappers (mc_*_sync over libmc), host: file I/O wrappers (over sce fileio), thread/semaphore utilities, busy_wait_delay

allocator.desc: pdistd::Allocator (heap allocator: rep blocks, alignment, debug dump using 'Allocator::debug' format strings), global heap init/stats, intr_suspend, global lock and break/abort stubs

printf.desc: pdistd::PrintFormatTargetBase and the printf format engine (printf.cxx), anonymous-namespace PrintTarget, tty_puts backend

libcdvd.desc: Sony libcdvd 2.2.x client (PsIIlibcdvd 2240): sceCdInit, N/S command RPC, sceCdRead, sceCdSearchFile, sceCdSync, sceCdDiskReady, callbacks, power-off handler

libpad.desc: Sony libpad 2.2.x (PsIIlibpad 2200): scePadInit, scePadPortOpen/Close, scePadRead, scePadGetState, scePadInfo*, press-mode, act DMA

libmc.desc: Sony libmc 2.2.x (PsIIlibmc 2240): sceMcInit, sceMcGetInfo, sceMcOpen/Read/Close/GetDir, sceMcSync, RPC end-callbacks; plus exec_ps2_with_sbus_cleanup at 0x01016F70 (decide from evidence whether it is SDK or game code and place it accordingly)

libgcc_eh.desc: GCC 2.9x-ee runtime: __main/__do_global_ctors/__do_global_dtors, setjmp/longjmp-style EH (__sjthrow, __sjpopnthrow, __throw, __rethrow, eh context), std::terminate/unexpected, set_terminate/set_unexpected, exception.cc

frame.desc: GCC 2.9x frame.c: DWARF2 unwind info registration and lookup (__register_frame_info, __deregister_frame_info, find_fde, fde sorting, CIE/FDE parsing, CFA interpreter, uleb/sleb decoding)

cxxrt.desc: libstdc++ (egcs/2.9x) runtime: operator new/delete (+ placement, arrays, nothrow), set_new_handler, bad_alloc, and tinfo.cc/tinfo2.cc RTTI (type_info, __class_type_info, __si_type_info, __user_type_info, dynamic_cast helpers, __rtti_* functions)

libc.desc: C library pieces (abort, memcpy, memmove, memset, strcat, strcpy, strcmp, strlen at 0x0100F538, __errno, memcmp) and libgraph's sceGsGetGParam / sceGsResetGraph (own .text.* sections at the end of text)

kernl_sys.desc: Sony libkernl 2.2.x (PsIIlibkernl2240) part 1: the EE kernel syscall stubs (0x0101B7C0.. 16-byte stubs, numbered), DI/EI, cache sync/invalidate, thread-server init, INTC/DMAC helpers, SIF DMA and SIF command layer (sceSifInitCmd, sceSifAddCmdHandler, sceSifSendCmd, system cmd handlers)

kernl_rpc_fio.desc: Sony libkernl part 2: SIF RPC client (sceSifInitRpc, sceSifBindRpc, sceSifCallRpc, sceSifCheckStatRpc, sceSifGetOtherData, rdata/bind requests) and fileio client (sceOpen/sceClose/sceRead/sceWrite/sceLseek/sceIoctl/sceDopen/..., fd table, RPC server 0x80000001)

kernl_rest.desc: Sony libkernl part 3: device fileio (sceDelDrv, sceDopen...), loadfile (sceSifLoadModule, sceSifLoadElf), IOP reboot (sceSifRebootIop / rom0:UDNL), iopheap, Deci2 / TTY driver, _InitSys (F_01022C18), sbrk/getpid/isatty/fstat newlib stubs

libgcc_math.desc: libgcc arithmetic helpers: 64-bit integer division (__divdi3, __moddi3, __udivdi3, __umoddi3, __udivmoddi4), float/double conversions (__fixunsdfdi, __floatdidf, ...), and fp-bit.c software double-precision float emulation (the EE FPU is single-precision only)
